notes: Governmental funds are modified cash basis (no liabilities), business-type funds accrual; basis marked cash, beginning/ending cash = governmental fund balances (printed fund balance 9/30/24 1,737,890 and total assets 1,423,231). Governmental identity: 1,737,890 + 1,295,994 - 2,110,653 + 500,000 = 1,423,231. Business-type (Enterprise Total column, p8; internal service fund excluded): 2,752,915 + 2,196,314 - 1,645,184 - 500,000 = 2,804,045; receipts = operating 2,131,517 + nonoperating 64,797 (computed total). Government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) total column includes the internal service fund (cash 56,597), so its cash differs from the governmental funds balance sheet. Transfer cross-check: CDA transfer in 500,000 (p5, p15) matches Electric 250,000 + Water 250,000 transfers to other funds (p8 and cash flows p9-10); no hidden transfers in spending lines. Transfers kept out of receipts and disbursements. Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p13) not recorded in detail because the General Fund departments combining schedule (pp16-17, more detailed, no budget column) is recorded instead; p13 General budget figures agree on totals (878,655 / actual spending 989,995 vs department total; p13 functional split differs). Street and CDA fund budget schedules recorded with final budget. No budgetary schedules exist for Electric, Water, Sewer or Sanitation funds in the trimmed PDF; proprietary fund-by-fund figures appear only in the primary statements (p6-12) and are covered in receipts/disbursements totals. Department columns: Police, C4K, Cemetery, Park, Pool, Library; the Total column was not duplicated. Street fund budget total resources 348,970 includes budgeted loan proceeds 125,000; actual loan proceeds nil. Proprietary cash flow statement p9-10; pp11-12 (gained in the v7 re-trim) are its reconciliation of operating income to net cash provided by operating activities (Total 628,503, matches p10) and add no new data. Read pages 1-17 of 17 C4K department (216) is general government (p13 General government 365,120 = General 364,904 + C4K 216). Cemetery department spending is health/welfare per the category rules although the report counts it under Public works (p13 57,420; p5 GF public works 48,470 = 57,420 less capital outlay 8,950). Internal service fund (p8: interdepartmental charges 33,000, insurance 24,831, interest 616) excluded as in other reports: its charges come from other city funds.
